title: Currency Codes (ISO 4217)
description: ISO 4127-compliant lookup for currency codes used on the site.

fields.name: code
fields.title: Currency Code
fields.description: [String] Standard currency alphabetic code according to ISO 4217 (e.g. 'MYR', 'USD')

fields.name: code_numeric
fields.title: Numeric Code
fields.description: [Integer] Standard currency numeric code according to ISO 4217 (e.g. 458 for MYR, 840 for USD)

fields.name: symbol
fields.title: Symbol
fields.description: [String] Most common symbol used for the currency

fields.name: suffix
fields.title: Suffix Indicator
fields.description: [Integer] 1 if the symbol is a suffix (i.e. after the monetary value), 0 if the symbol is a prefix.

methodology: Alpha codes, numeric codes, and currency names are fully compliant with the [ISO 4217](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html) standard. Symbols and suffix indicators were added by the open data team to assist with internal operations.
